newsitem.title: INDIA: India Escorts' JV completes signs loans.
newsitem.headline: India Escorts' JV completes signs loans.

text.p: Escotel Mobile Telecommunication Ltd on Monday announced the signing of two loans towards funding requirements of its cellular networks in India.
Escotel is a joint venture of which 51 percent is owned by Indian firm Escorts Ltd and 49 percent by First Pacific Co of Hong Kong.
The company is setting up a cellular phone network in western Uttar Pradesh and Haryana (both in northern India) and in Kerala in south India, it said in a statement.
"Chase Manhattan Asia Ltd lead managed the $129 million external commercial borrowing syndication," Escotel siad.
A 1.25 billion rupees onshore facility was arranged by the Infrastructure Leasing and Financial Services Corp (ILFS).
This rupee term loan was subscribed by ILFS, Housing Finance Development Corp, State Bank of India, ANZ Grindlays and Sakura Bank, Escotel said.
